title: Manual of the Paired Sword Heart
summary: A manual that joins the sword heart to a twin of itself so every cut and guard is made in pairs and ends in one sovereign stroke.

title: Treatise on the Hawk's Unfolding Blade
summary: A treatise on the hawk's folded wing and the blade that unfolds from it in a sweep of qi.

title: Canon of the Dual Sword Tracks
summary: A canon of parallel strokes run down two tracks of qi so that one line opens the guard and the other closes on it.

title: Compendium of the Azure Edge
summary: A compendium of pale blue edges of qi that cut cleanly and bind and shield with the same color of force.

title: Treatise on the Returning River Edge
summary: A treatise on cuts that flow out and flow back along the same line so that each stroke is also its own answer.

title: Canon of the Hawk and Azure Blade
summary: A canon that couples the stoop of the hawk to the clear light of the azure edge in a sovereign dive of the blade.

title: Manual of the Oath-Sworn Sword Heart
summary: A manual that binds the sword heart to a sworn oath so the blade holds its line against every pressure.

title: Treatise on the Unyielding Edge
summary: A treatise on an edge that bears no bend and a guard that gives no ground though the wind of the attack rises.

title: The Wind-Sworn Bearing Canon
summary: A canon of the blade sworn to the wind and the bearing taken against it and held until the edge lands.

title: Compendium of the Unwalled Edge
summary: A compendium of open sword work with no wall and no fixed line where the blade is free to answer from anywhere.

title: Manual of the Long Oath and the Open Blade
summary: A manual that carries one oath through a long fight with an open blade and gathers its strength to a single suppressing stroke.

title: Treatise on the Bearing Held Without Walls
summary: A treatise on keeping the bearing with the bare blade and no wall of any kind between the edge and its mark.
